title: SecurityEventSchema
description: Schema for validating security events, enrichment results, confidence levels, approvals, and audit trails.
$comment: This schema enforces the structured normalization of security logs, automated enrichments, human/AI approval workflows, and audit trails. Designed for Arzens Internship Program - Assignment 1.

event_id.description: Auto-generated UUIDv4 unique identifier for the event.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 normalized UTC timestamp of the event.

source.description: The system, host, network device, or application that generated the log.

event_type.description: The category of the log event.

severity.description: The severity level of the event.

indicator.description: The IP address, domain, or hash matched by threat intel.

source.description: The threat intelligence feed or database name.

threat_type.description: The type of threat (e.g., botnet, phishing, scanner).

related_events.description: UUIDs of related events detected within the context window.

confidence.description: Numeric confidence score and metadata about what fields it applies to.

score.description: The confidence score from 0.0 (no confidence) to 1.0 (absolute certainty).

scale.description: The defined scale of the confidence score.

applies_to.description: The list of fields or predictions to which this confidence score applies (e.g., event_type, threat_intel_matches).

approval.description: The status of human/AI approval for remediation actions related to this event.

approver_id.description: The ID of the human analyst or AI system that approved/rejected the action.

approval_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the approval decision.

audit_trail.description: An ordered list of actions taken on this event.

id.description: The unique ID of the actor (user or system).

type.description: Whether the actor is a human analyst or automated system.

action.description: The action taken (e.g., Alert Triage, Host Quarantine, Status Update).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the action occurred.
